what: Large decorations fixed behind the screen (top arch · leaves · fruit) fold upward over 0.3s ease-out once scrolled past 100px — the arch rises 250px while squashed to 0.5x vertically (about its center), and the leaves and fruit rise 150 and 180px. Near the top again, they unfold. It is a state change not tied to scroll amount, so it folds at once even when scrolled slowly

options.at: Scroll distance at which it folds (px), default 100
options.[data-fx-part=squash]: Panel that rises while pressed (arch) — --fx-squash-y(-250px) · --fx-squash(.5), at 1024 and below --fx-squash-y-narrow(-130px) · --fx-squash-narrow(.4)
options.[data-fx-part=lift]: Decoration that rises as is (leaves, fruit) — --fx-lift(-150px), and at 1024 or below --fx-lift-narrow(-115px)

note: squash uses transform, lift uses the translate property — so lift does not conflict even if the decoration already has a transform
